title: Suppose We Did

[Intro: solo piano, simple rocking figure]

As long as any road
And nobody went hungry
And nobody was owed

[Verse 2: soft strings enter]
Suppose the maps were pencil
And the borders rubbed away
Suppose we all woke early
With nothing to repay

[Chorus: voice lifts, bass and light drums]

But somebody has to say it

Suppose we did

And what they're hoping for

[Chorus: voice lifts, bass and light drums]
I know how it sounds, believe me
I have heard it since I was ten
But somebody has to say it
Or we never start, and then
Suppose we did

[Outro: piano alone, last line nearly spoken]
Pull up a chair
Suppose we did
